[[High Inquisitor]] [[Mox Slosin]] owned a '''palace''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Urce]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="AIR84">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mox Slosin]] terrorized the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]] from his palace on [[Urce]],<ref name="TCSWEIII169" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the area.<ref name="TCSWEIII282">{{CSWECite|III|282|Urce}}</ref>

Slosin did not spend much time in his palace, however, as he actively patrolled his jurisdiction in his modified [[Trenchant-class cruiser|''Trenchant''-class cruiser]], the [[Ironhand (Trenchant-class)|''Ironhand'']], searching out [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]].<ref name="TCSWEIII169" /><ref name="AIR84" />
